data.title: Winter at Darb Zubaida Offers Stargazing, Astronomy Workshops
data.content:
Rafha, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Imam Turki bin Abdullah Royal Nature Reserve Development Authority is organizing astronomy workshops as part of the Winter at Darb Zubaida season from November 19 to 22. The sessions run daily from 8 p.m. to midnight, offering visitors an opportunity to explore the night sky and learn about astronomical phenomena.
    The workshops introduce visitors to the role of stars in Arab heritage, including Quranic references, the story of Prophet Abraham and his people, the story of the People of the Cave, and mentions in Arabic poetry. Participants also learn the Arabic names of celestial bodies and how stars were used for navigation and identifying agricultural seasons. Laser demonstrations help visitors locate stars in the night sky.
    Visitors can observe the moon, planets, nebulae, and galaxies through telescopes. The program also highlights the reserve's efforts to preserve vegetation, combat desertification, and improve local environmental conditions, including clearer skies.
    The authority invited the public to attend during the scheduled dates. For inquiries, visitors can call 920022077.
    -- SPA
